/* Code node 1: "Write the search brief" */
const REGIONS = ["Europe", "North America", "Middle East", "Asia-Pacific", "Africa", "South America"];
const VERTICALS = ["Payments", "PSP", "Acquiring", "Fintech", "Banking", "Open Banking",
  "Treasury", "Marketplaces", "E-commerce", "Cross-border E-commerce", "Retail",
  "Travel", "Travel Tech", "Stablecoin", "Digital Assets", "Policy"];

const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r && r.name);
let fromBody = [];
try { fromBody = $('Webhook').first().json.body.known || []; } catch (e) { fromBody = []; }

const known = [...new Set([...rows.map(r => r.name), ...fromBody])];
const knownIds = rows.map(r => r.id).filter(Boolean);
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const system = [
  "You find business conferences, using web search.",
  "",
  "Who this is for: Grain sells embedded cross-currency FX hedging. Their",
  "customers are companies that move money across currencies for other",
  "people: payment service providers, marketplaces, travel platforms,",
  "payroll providers, BNPL lenders, stablecoin infrastructure, and corporate",
  "treasury teams. Their sales team goes to conferences to meet those",
  "companies, so an event is only useful if those buyers attend it.",
  "",
  "Rules:",
  "1. Search the web. Only return an event if a page you actually read says",
  "   it exists. Never invent an event, a date, a city or an attendance",
  "   figure, and never carry one over from memory without checking.",
  "2. If a field was not on the page you read, set it to null. A null is a",
  "   correct answer. A guess is not.",
  "3. url must be a page you actually opened during this search.",
  "4. Prefer events taking place in the next 12 months. Today is " + today + ".",
  "5. Return a JSON array and nothing else. No prose, no code fence.",
].join("\n");

const prompt = [
  "The team already tracks these " + known.length + " events:",
  known.map(n => "- " + n).join("\n"),
  "",
  "Find up to 6 events that are NOT in that list and that Grain's sales team",
  "should know about. Each element of the array:",
  "{",
  '  "name": string,',
  '  "start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null,',
  '  "end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null,',
  '  "city": string or null,',
  '  "country": string or null,',
  '  "region": one of ' + JSON.stringify(REGIONS) + ',',
  '  "verticals": 1 to 3 of ' + JSON.stringify(VERTICALS) + ',',
  '  "audience_size": integer or null,',
  '  "url": string,',
  '  "why": one sentence, 25 words max, on which of Grain\'s buyers are in that room',
  "}",
].join("\n");

return [{ json: { known, knownIds, system, prompt } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', max_tokens: 4000, system: $json.system, tools: [{ type: 'web_search_20250305', name: 'web_search', max_uses: 8 }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}
